summary.content:
Today's selection covers 85 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 51 on Artificial Intelligence and 20 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Canva’s new editing tool adds layers to AI-generated designs
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Michelin Confirms Data Breach Linked to Oracle EBS Attack
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights phishing, data breaches, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from The Verge, SecurityWeek, TechCrunch, BBC Technology, NY Times Tech and others
• **Fresh Content**: 49 articles published in the last 24 hours
